text: The stereo pipeline: two IMX219 on cam0/cam1 via Ansible boot overlays, the restored camera_ros SyncMode patch, two synced 480x360 5 fps cameras, the restored and adapted stereo_depth node (SGBM 48 disparities), the calibration tool, background cgroup tier, metrics, lint/CI registration and docs.
The depth contract and overview role: depth on the ToF contract (16UC1 mm, 0 = invalid) shown in the Head tab, and the left camera keeps the /overview_camera topics so every consumer keeps working.
